name: save-boot-11d-battle-command-rows
description: #171 attempt 3, first menu. From "stats-battle" (party Cloud, Barret, Tifa; a random battle in md1_1): wait until the widget id reads 1 (open_wait), 30 frames; the slot reads 2 (slot2, within 1 frame) and slot 2's row reads 0 (r2_zero, within 1 frame); Down every 20 frames (held 4) until slot 2's row reads 3 (r2_down), Up every 20 frames until it reads 0 (r2_up), 10 frames. End: slot 2's row 0, the other slots' rows 0, still battle; match: a rerun from the same snapshot. A wait metric is the frames waited, 0 on a timeout (which stops the script). row* at the end are the other slots' rows (0-255), which must not move. With no materia (the stats-battle save) the command menu has no Magic or Summon row, and Down goes from Attack (row 0) to Item (row 3): #171 attempt 2 read row 3 after one Down press in both menus, with every other row still 0.
